verdict.rationale: Evidence shows registrar-level transfer lock functionality: the RDAP record for namecheap.com shows 'client transfer prohibited'/'server transfer prohibited' statuses, and the official Go SDK exposes SetRegistrarLockWithContext to lock/unlock a domain at the registrar. However, there is no documentation of a dedicated registry-lock (registry-level, manual-verification) feature for high-value domains, nor confirmation that transfer lock is on-by-default for all customer domains as a policy. Missing for 10: explicit registry-lock product/option documentation, default-lock policy statement, and independent verification of registry-lock availability.
